About Us

Who we are

IT-Tech Consulting provides professional diagnostics, repairs, maintenance, and installations for all your technology needs. Our services are delivered by trained personnel and certified professionals with over 16 years of experience in the tech sector. We can source whatever you need; our operations leverage existing hardware suppliers for IT and electronic products, with a focus on servicing IT infrastructure and Industry 4.0 technologies.

We offer a complete project solution, from minor repairs to large-scale installations, servicing systems in all sectors. We know the local landscape, and we are ready to assess and effect solutions wherever you are located within the Cape Town Metropolitan and surrounding areas.

Services

What we offer

We offer IT Infrastructure and Industry 4.0 solutions as a service, with options for standard setups or customised solutions crafted for your specific needs — from private home setups and small businesses to large-scale enterprise networks.

Workstation Support & SOHO

  • Workstation SupportSolving software and hardware issues for laptops and desktops, and installing upgrades to boost speed and extend the life of the machine.
  • Software Deployment & SupportManaging the efficient rollout and ongoing support for enterprise software, including Microsoft 365, AWS and other SaaS platforms.
  • SOHO SetupsReliable internet, secure networks, printers and workstations so you can focus on work instead of IT problems.

Hardware Lifecycle & Continuity

  • Hardware Lifecycle ManagementSourcing, installation, repairs and maintenance of computers, servers and peripherals.
  • End-User Technical SupportPrompt, professional on-site and remote help desk services to minimise employee downtime.
  • Business Continuity & Disaster RecoveryRigorous backup protocols and comprehensive recovery plans to maintain operations.

Servers, Networks & Cloud

  • Server Management & SupportInstalling, configuring, monitoring and maintaining your core office servers.
  • Network Infrastructure ManagementEngineering reliable and secure LAN, WAN and Wi-Fi environments.
  • Cloud Infrastructure & MigrationTransitioning digital assets to scalable public, private or hybrid cloud platforms.

Smart City & Industry 4.0 Systems

  • Smart ParkingSensor-guided systems that direct drivers to available spots, reducing search times and traffic.
  • Waste CollectionSmart bins fitted with sensors that optimise collection routes and schedules.
  • Energy ManagementSmart grids, UPS systems and meters, often integrating renewable sources like solar power.
  • Smart LightingNetworked lighting with motion and ambient sensors to save energy.
  • Smart GreenhousesIoT sensors and automated controls for optimal growing conditions.

Networked Appliances & Wireless Systems

  • Terrestrial & SatelliteUHF/VHF communication systems, satellite networking including DStv, OVHD and WANs.
  • IT & IoT NetworksServicing wireless technologies for residential and commercial environments.

Machine Connectivity & Monitoring

  • IIoT & OT SystemsServicing electronic monitoring systems using wired and/or wireless networks.
  • Wireless networking and supportIncluding 5G, Wi-Fi, LoRaWAN, TETRA, cellular, Zigbee, UHF, VHF, WirelessHART, NB-IoT, etc.
Contact Us

Get a budget-friendly quote

Contact us for a budget-friendly solution for all your IT infrastructure and electronics-related queries, from basic IT services right through to advanced electronic systems integrations. We are committed to delivering quality servicing at reasonable rates.

Our consultation fee covers the initial call-out and onsite diagnostics; the first hour of labour is included in this charge, while additional labour hours, repairs or installations are billed according to our pricing terms below.

Additional costs are applicable for, but are not limited to: specialist equipment/software, parts and materials (quoted separately), travel fees (outside of our service areas), and other related costs. Installation fees for projects exceeding 8 hours are determined by the scope of work — a detailed quotation is provided after an initial assessment. Fixed price agreements are available on a per-service basis, terms and conditions apply.
